title_zh: 依据来源卡核对燃料展品标签

scenario.label_zh: 核对博物馆燃料展品标签
scenario.goal_zh: 依据来源卡确认煤与木材样本，只写有记录支持的材料和来源信息

context_zh: 博物馆志愿者和馆员根据现有来源记录，给课堂展示用的燃料样本写标签。
author: author-phase05-a

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: I have two labels left, but I do not want to guess which sample is which.

sentences.speaker: Curator Ellis
sentences.text: Check the cards underneath the trays. What does the first one say?

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: Coal from the old school store. So this black lump belongs with the school display.

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: It says wood from the farm kitchen. I can still see the bark on that piece.

sentences.speaker: Curator Ellis
sentences.text: Use those descriptions on the labels. Do not add a date unless it is on the card.

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: Neither card gives a date. I will label the material and the recorded location only.

sentences.speaker: Curator Ellis
sentences.text: Good. Put each card behind its matching label so we can check it later.
